question: _______ is a mode of communication in itself, and it also regulates the use of other means of communication.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satellite**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The satellite is an artificial object which has been deliberately put into space for various purposes like remote sensing, image mapping, weather forecasting, education, and research.
 
• A satellite is a moon, planet, or machine that orbits a planet or star.
 
• For example, Earth is a satellite because it orbits the sun.
 
• Likewise, the moon is a satellite because it orbits Earth.
 
• Usually, the word "satellite" refers to a machine that is launched into space and moves around Earth or another body in space.

 

 
 

 Type of Satellite__
 __Uses__
 
 

 Communication Satellite
 
 __
 
• Communications satellites allow radio, television, and telephone transmissions to be sent live anywhere in the world.
 
• Example-INSAT Series of India
 
 
 
 

 Navigation Satellite
 
 
 
• Used for geo-spatial positioning with global coverage
 
 
• Example - GAGAN
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Remote Sensing Satellite
 
 
 
• Used for observing and measuring environmental events
 
 
• IRS satellite series
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Space Exploration Satellites
 
 
 
• They are not really satellites
 
• Known as Space proves
 
• Used to send back detailed pictures and atmospheric data of plantes
 
• Ex. - Chandrayan
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Soviet Union launched the world's first artificial satellite, Sputnik 1 on 4 October 1957.
 
• The first Indian Satellite "Aryabhatta" was launched on 19 April 1975.
 
• Aryabhata, Bhaskara-I, Rohini RS-D2, INSAT-2DT, GSAT-1, Cartosat-3, etc are the Indian satellites.
